ns2:course.label: Treat and Prevent of Sub Abuse
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the issue of substance abuse and its impact on society; addresses the physiological, psychological, social, and cultural aspects of substance abuse. At the individual and family level, examines the causes, development, and treatment of substance abuse. At the societal level, examines public policy and service issues regarding the treatment and prevention of abuse. Special attention devoted to examining substance abuse issues among diverse population groups. Prerequisite: Admission to MSW program or consent of instructor
